title: AmazingChat
body:
Bored from the chat formatting plugins that are difficult to configure? AmazingChat is here to fix that. AmazingChat provides a permission based chat formatting system + 4 extra modules.
## Modules:
- Private Messages
- Mentions
- Chat lockdown
- Chat clearing
## Other features:
- You can give players a special permission to chat with colors.
- MariaDB and SQLite support to store player data.
## Useful information
- The plugin is tested on PaperMC, Pufferfish and PurpurMC 1.21.4-1.21.8 (You can try in other forks!). **SPIGOT IS TOTALLY NOT SUPPORTED**.
- You need to check the [wiki](https://cubicdev.gitbook.io/amazingchat) to understand the plugin.
- Full MiniMessage and PlaceholderAPI support.
- The plugin has an easy and pretty configuration for general configs, modules and formats.
- Full customization in every configuration or message.
